items.title: Georg Brunis Interview, 1958-06-03
items.q: No, it was Williams, Joe Farrow, uh, well, I expect everyone to know, Williams, Farrow, and somebody else.

ctx.x: Yeah. I love that. What about the piano players in New Orleans? Were there many of them?
No, it was Williams, Joe Farrow, uh, well, I expect everyone to know, Williams, Farrow, and somebody else. Can't think of them.
Some of those early dance bands then you played but didn't even use piano.
